connection_authentication.limitations: No APK could be downloaded (see ANALYSIS.md §5), so no static scan of the app binary for HMAC/Mac.init references was possible. The transport (SSH/VPN connection) was not investigated.
connection_authentication.material_provenance: format constants from the repo decoder (SSCCUSTOM.py)
connection_authentication.scope: No HMAC or connection-authentication material was observed in the scope reviewed (file/text format only: the .ssc envelope is ChaCha20 + JSON with fixed app-embedded keys; no MAC, no per-session negotiation, no Keystore material). The server decoder and the Kotlin port contain no HMAC reference for SSC. NOT_OBSERVED describes only this reviewed coverage; it does not prove the app never uses HMAC elsewhere (e.g. in its live SSH/VPN transport, which this dossier does not cover).

limitations: No real .ssc file exported by SSC Custom 4.3.13 was available; all positives are synthetic round-trips. Status is VERIFIED_SYNTHETIC, not VERIFIED.

No APK downloaded: APKPure returned 403 to curl, APKCombo returned an HTML page instead of the APK, APKMirror was unreachable from this VM. Native libraries per split could therefore not be listed; none are needed for this format (pure ChaCha20 + JSON, no native dependency).
The two server-decoder quirks are reproduced deliberately (see ANALYSIS.md §4); if the server decoder is ever fixed, the offline decoder must be re-aligned.
Offline APK not compiled here (no Android SDK in this VM); CI must compile it.
manual_steps: CI must build the offline APK (offline-native-apk workflow) and Pedro must install it and import one real .ssc exported by SSC Custom 4.3.13 to promote the status to VERIFIED.
If a real file fails to open, capture the exact error code (SSC_INVALID_L1 / SSC_UNSUPPORTED_LAYER / ...) and attach the file hash, not the file.
network_requirements: None at runtime. The decoder is 100% offline: fixed keys, no server, no download, no account.
rights: Public Play listing + public repo decoder; no APK downloaded (mirrors blocked direct fetch from this VM), no private sample, no credentials. All fixtures are synthetic.
